The issue was that X_train and Y_train were converted to numpy arrays in cell 3 (using .values), but cell 4 tried to use .join() which is a pandas DataFrame method. Changed from `train_houseprice=X_train.join(Y_train)` to `train_houseprice=pd.DataFrame(X_train).join(pd.DataFrame(Y_train, columns=['price']))`.
